title: Made to look like cardboard Ziplock bag organizer; unique & artsy but low quality
text:
Made to look like cardboard Ziplock bag organizer; unique & artsy but low quality. This is a basic labeled four-compartment Ziplock bag organizer with one opening each for different types of bags such as quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. It is an artsy unit and I love the puzzle latch that bends back and allows the faceplate to flip up. This has two holes to hang on the wall but the screws and plastic mollies are NOT provided. It can also be placed in a drawer that is large enough to hold it. There are rubberized circles provided to prevent this from slipping around in a drawer; all I had to do was stick them to the back of the unit (see photo).

The bags can be loaded through the opening or by lifting the faceplate. This is a basic but functional organizer that is made to look like cardboard. It is a bit cheaply made in that some of the front was peeling away (see photo). However, it is still very functional as it does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets.

The current price of $20.99 is competitively priced for this and is commensurate with the quality of the unit. Other options that are available for organizers like this are this [[ASIN:B09D5Y63D1 one]] if one is looking for four separate compartments. For a variety of organizers (separate and one unit), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]]. For a larger unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires.
